reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(pp.promo_id) AS n_promotions
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.brand = 'Cablemate'
GROUP BY p.product_name
alternatives: SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(pp.promo_id) AS n_promotions FROM promotion_products pp RIGHT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id WHERE p.brand = 'Cablemate' GROUP BY p.product_name

SELECT p.product_name, SUM(CASE WHEN pp.promo_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS n_promotions FROM products p LEFT JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.brand = 'Cablemate' GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(CASE WHEN pp.promo_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS n_promotions FROM products p LEFT JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.brand = 'Cablemate' GROUP BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: A CASE that adds 1 for each match gives the same counts, but COUNT of a bridge column is shorter.
